facts.text: The inn is in the town of Los Olivos in the Santa Ynez Valley, in Santa Barbara County, California.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of Los Olivos, The Inn at Mattei’s Tavern will celebrate the relaxed attitude and pioneering spirit of the Santa Ynez Valley.
